recipe:
let garment_waist: length = waist_girth + ease_waist
let garment_hip: length = hip_girth + ease_hip
let quarter_waist: length = garment_waist / 4
let quarter_hip: length = garment_hip / 4
let suppression: length = quarter_hip - quarter_waist
assert dart_derivation: eps_num = dart_intake == suppression - ss_suppress
assert allocation_balance: eps_num = 4 * (ss_suppress + dart_intake) == garment_hip - garment_waist
let waist_side_x: length = quarter_hip - ss_suppress
let front_dart_centre: length = waist_side_x / 2
let back_dart_centre: length = waist_side_x / 2
assert waist_closure: eps_num = (quarter_hip - ss_suppress) - dart_intake == quarter_waist
let side_seam_total: length = 4 * ss_suppress
let dart_total: length = 4 * dart_intake
let quarter_hem_width: length = quarter_hip + a_line_flare
let garment_hem: length = 4 * quarter_hem_width
let hip_to_hem_drop: length = waist_to_hem - waist_to_hip
let side_seam_length: length = hypot(hip_to_hem_drop, a_line_flare)
let waistband_pattern_length: length = garment_waist + 2 * sa_cb + wb_extension
let waistband_cut_width: length = 2 * wb_width + sa_waist + sa_wb_bottom
let waistband_fold_position: length = waistband_cut_width / 2
let waistband_finished_length: length = waistband_pattern_length - 2 * sa_cb
let wb_interfacing_width: length = wb_width
let wb_interfacing_length: length = waistband_finished_length
assert waistband_length_closure: eps_num = waistband_pattern_length - 2 * sa_cb - wb_extension == garment_waist
assert waistband_width_closure: eps_num = waistband_cut_width - sa_waist - sa_wb_bottom == 2 * wb_width
let half_dart: length = dart_intake / 2
let front_dart_lo: length = front_dart_centre - half_dart
let front_dart_hi: length = front_dart_centre + half_dart
let back_dart_lo: length = back_dart_centre - half_dart
let back_dart_hi: length = back_dart_centre + half_dart
let hip_ctrl_y: length = -waist_to_hip / 2
let waist_ctrl_x: length = quarter_hip - ss_suppress + ss_suppress / 3
let waist_ctrl_y: length = -waist_to_hip / 6
let grain_x: length = quarter_hip / 2
let notch_depth: length = 0.5 cm
let side_notch_x: length = quarter_hip + sa_side
let side_notch_aim_x: length = side_notch_x - notch_depth
let zip_aim_x: length = -sa_cb + notch_depth
let band_notch_1: length = sa_cb + quarter_waist
let band_notch_2: length = sa_cb + 2 * quarter_waist
let band_notch_3: length = sa_cb + 3 * quarter_waist
let band_notch_4: length = sa_cb + 4 * quarter_waist
let band_right_x: length = waistband_pattern_length - sa_cb
let band_top_y: length = waistband_cut_width - sa_wb_bottom
let band_grain_inset: length = 2 cm
let band_grain_start: length = sa_cb + band_grain_inset
let band_grain_end: length = waistband_pattern_length - sa_cb - band_grain_inset
let band_grain_y: length = waistband_cut_width / 4
let ifc_inset: length = 1 cm
let ifc_end: length = wb_interfacing_length - ifc_inset
let ifc_mid_y: length = wb_interfacing_width / 2
let label_x: length = 6 cm
let label_y: length = -30 cm
let band_label_x: length = 40 cm
let band_label_y: length = 7 cm
let ifc_label_x: length = 30 cm
let ifc_label_y: length = 2 cm

labels.text: skirt_front, size M, cut 1, shell, colorway not specified, place on fold
skirt_back_right, size M, cut 1, shell, colorway not specified, R
skirt_back_left, size M, cut 1, shell, colorway not specified, L
waistband, size M, cut 1, shell, colorway not specified
waistband_interfacing, size M, cut 1, interfacing, colorway not specified
